faces.name: The Naked Time
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Search your library for a basic Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
II — Whenever a creature you control enters this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it and it gains haste until end of turn.
III — Sacrifice a land.

faces.name: Thendar, the Overminer
faces.oracleText:
Menace
Whenever a nonbasic land is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, its controller conjures a card named Wastes onto the battlefield tapped.
At the beginning of your end step, if you control two or more tapped creatures, destroy up to one target nonbasic land.

faces.name: Then, Dreadmaws Ate Everyone
faces.oracleText: Create X 6/6 green Dinosaur creature tokens with trample named Colossal Dreadmaw.

faces.name: The Necrobloom
faces.oracleText:
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 0/1 green Plant creature token. If you control seven or more lands with different names, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token instead.
Land cards in your graveyard have dredge 2. (You may return a land card from your graveyard to your hand and mill two cards instead of drawing a card.)

faces.name: The Needs of the Many
faces.oracleText:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Creatures you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. You gain hexproof until end of turn. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you this turn. Exile The Needs of the Many.

faces.name: The Neutrinos
faces.oracleText:
Flying
Alliance — Whenever another creature you control enters, The Neutrinos get +1/+0 until end of turn.
Whenever The Neutrinos attack, exile up to one target creature you own, then return it to the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.

faces.name: The Night of the Doctor
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after II.)
I — Destroy all creatures.
II — Return target legendary creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Put your choice of a first strike, vigilance, or lifelink counter on it.

faces.name: The Ninth Doctor
faces.oracleText:
Haste
Into the TARDIS — Whenever The Ninth Doctor becomes untapped during your untap step, you get an additional upkeep step after this step.
